data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 3117, patchset 2 (commit 27772912f3a; LLM-Review +1 04:28 PDT, Verified +1 04:44 PDT, 0 unresolved). It took 6 plan reviews, 4 combined verify runs and 2 patchsets; the course is recorded here because it changed the plan.

What landed (8 files): .test_durations (new, 2643913 bytes, sorted JSON, 19862 keys), .gitignore (stops ignoring it), .pre-commit-config.yaml (check-added-large-files exclude is now ^(uv\.lock|\.test_durations)$), docs/local-dev-env.md (new section 'Per-test durations (.test_durations)'), scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py + tests/unit/test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py (exclusion + one parameter case), tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py (allowlist entry), .gitleaks.toml (third targeted allowlist, fake PEM shape). The recording run used the unoverridden default PYTEST_WORKERS=4.

Red proofs, before any change (2026-10-26 00:08 PDT): 'git ls-files .test_durations' printed nothing. A 528892-byte stand-in staged with 'git add -f' under the old exclude made 'pre-commit run check-added-large-files --files .test_durations' fail: '.test_durations (517 KB) exceeds 500 KB'.

What went wrong on the way (each fixed, each found one at a time):
1. Run 1 (00:11 PDT) failed the repo-isolation backstop ('?? .test_durations', tests/_isolation.py:150): pytest-split wrote to its default path in the checkout. Fix: write to the ignored .rebar/scratch via --durations-path and cp it in. Log kept as make-verify-e873-attempt1-isolation-failure.log.
2. The original criterion 'group 1 of 4 collects a quarter of the suite' was wrong: pytest-split balances by recorded time, not count. Corrected in the plan, the docs and the criterion.
3. 'pre-commit run --all-files' failed (about 01:16 PDT) in lint: scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py flagged 19 lines of the profile (test ids of the migrate_success_criteria tests quote retired vocabulary). Fix: EXCLUDED_FILES entry plus a parameter case. Before: 1 failed, 3 passed, 44 deselected. After: 48 passed.
4. Run 3 (01:18 to 02:10 PDT, 51:38 min) ended 18 failed: the 17 known pandoc failures plus tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py::test_no_uncategorized_live_old_spelling. To find any other repo-wide scanner I ran the full 'make lint' (exit 0) and the 20 other modules that read tracked files: 274 passed, 1 failed (this one). Fix: _WHOLE_FILE_ALLOWLIST entry. Before: 1 failed, 8 passed. After: 9 passed.
5. Patchset 1 (03:16 PDT) got LLM-Review -1 at 03:22 PDT: the review bot's gitleaks private-key rule matched 3 locations of the profile, all parametrize ids of test_create_rejects_all_private_key_headers (a fake PEM header, a body of x, an END line). Only the review bot could have shown this one. Fix: a third targeted allowlist for that exact fake shape, plus the docs advisory (they quoted run-2 split numbers; the docs now give none). Measured with the review bot's exact command (gitleaks detect --no-banner --no-git --source <dir> --exit-code 0, no --config) on a scratch tree: profile with the old config 3 findings; with the new config 0; a real-shaped control key (200-character random body) still 1 finding.

The recording run (run 4, 02:19 PDT start, log make-verify-e873-attempt4-pushed-ps1.log): 17 failed, 19746 passed, 107 skipped, 48 warnings in 3088.71s (0:51:28); outside-reconciler failures 0, ERROR lines 0, isolation 0, head-moved 0; host load at its start 17.8/13.9/14.5, so the times are rough relative weights, not a budget. Profile installed 03:12 PDT: 19862 keys == 19862 collected ids ('19862/20180 tests collected (318 deselected)'); nodes without a key 0; keys without a collected node 0; total recorded time 12075 s. For --splits 4 the groups hold 2518/1612/8245/7487 tests (sum 19862) with estimated durations 3020.81/3023.61/3021.05/3009.72 s, at most 0.30% from a quarter (3018.8 s). The longest single test is 67.0 s, 2.22% of a quarter, well inside a 5% band. 'pre-commit run --all-files' exit 0, 7 hooks passed (about 03:14 PDT). Reverting the exclude on the real file: '.test_durations (2582 KB) exceeds 500 KB'; restored: skipped. Patchset 2 plain make verify (03:26 to 04:19 PDT, 52:16 min): 17 failed (all under tests/unit/reconciler), 19746 passed, 107 skipped, 0 outside, 0 ERROR, 0 isolation, 0 head-moved; the profile was unchanged afterwards (19862 keys).

Merged main (HEAD 27772912f3a), 2026-10-26 04:46 PDT: git ls-files .test_durations prints it; 19862 keys; 'python scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py' exit 0; test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py plus test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py 57 passed; 'python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check' exit 0; bot-style gitleaks on a scratch tree: profile 0 findings, with the real-shaped control 1 finding (the control only); 'pytest --splits 4 --group 1 --collect-only' -> 2518/20180 tests collected.

Advisories accepted, not acted on (a new patchset would have restarted CI and a 50-minute verify): (1) no regression test for the gitleaks allowlist -> follow-up task assiduous-ribbony-mousebird (5c17-6b70-c4ae-4f92), which reuses test_repo_gitleaks_config_allowlists_doc_throwaway_but_not_real_secret; (2) the profile has no provenance pin and can go stale (inherent; refreshed by a deliberate re-run only, and the held-out merge epic traitorous-official-sunbittern re-records it); (3) the gitleaks allowlist is scoped by content shape, so a future one-x-body PEM anywhere is also exempt (a deliberate trade-off); (4) the exclude is an anchored regex.

Unverified: whether a further scan that is only visible in CI exists (CI passed on the Linux gate for this change, so none flagged it there); the profile's usefulness for real splitting, since nothing in CI consumes it yet.
